# Every form of GNU's m68k opcode table that the 68030 has and no CPU
# before it in tools/fuzz/m68k.py's CORPUS_ORDER does, one line each, with
# operands that form takes and no earlier form of the mnemonic does.
# Motorola syntax, checked against GNU as --mri.
#
#   tools/fuzz/m68k.py corpus --first --cpu 68030 --syntax mot

	pmove	(a1),tt1
	pmove	tt0,ext+4
	pmovefd	($3e8,d3.w*4),tc
	pmovefd	$3a90,crp
	pmovefd	a5,tt0
